.TH MAKEG 1 Release 6.6 X Version 11"
.SH NAME
makeg \- make a debuggable executable
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B makeg
[
.I make-options .\|.\|.
] [
.I targets .\|.\|.
]
.SH DESCRIPTION

The

.I makeg
script runs
.I make,
passing it variable settings to create a debuggable target when used with a Makefile generated by
.I imake.

For example, it arranges for the C compiler to be called with the

.B \-g
option.
.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP 8
.B MAKE

The

.I make
program to use. Default ``make''.
.TP 8
.B GDB

Set to a non-null value if using the

.I gdb
debugger on Solaris 2, which requires additional debugging options to be passed to the compiler.
.SH SEE ALSO"
.I make (1),
